skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA017
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA017. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: Aww, I can't finish all these cakes on my own. What do I do~

skins.name: Distinguished Visitor
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Distinguished Visitor. The outfit worn by Angelina while she was stationed at the 2nd Final Defense Front. The substance of reality slowly flows between her fingers and her tools.
skins.usage: One of Angelina's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Captain, I'll handle things here. You're still needed elsewhere.'
